info.description: Service detail pages: hero copy, media and the case studies / tech stack each service relates to

parent.description: Page this service is listed under (e.g. the Services hub). The public URL is the parent's path plus the slug.

sections.description: The page content, in the order shown here. Add, remove and drag to reorder — the published page follows this order.

caseStudies.description: Case studies delivered with this service. The link is the same one as 'Services' on each case study — filling it in here also lists this service there, and vice versa. Case-study sections on this page use these as their default set when you do not pick cases manually, and the Cases filters use them too.

techStack.description: Technologies used to deliver this service. The link is the same one as 'Services' on each technology. A Tech Stack section on this page lists these in order unless you pick technologies on the section itself.
